summary: Frontend-only verification of language-aware SplashScreen. Cleared service workers + caches in a fresh browser context, then for each of lang=en/de/el: set localStorage tj_lang, reloaded, and read document.querySelector('[data-testid="splash-screen"] img').getAttribute('src'). All three languages resolved to the correct asset AND the image actually loaded (naturalWidth=848, naturalHeight=1264 for each). Greek splash also visually confirmed via screenshot (Ξεκίνα δωρεάν).

test_results.assets_reachable: PASS - GET /splash-en.png, /splash-de.png, /splash-el.png all return 200 with content-type image/png (sizes ~1.16MB, 1.41MB, 1.21MB)
test_results.splash_lang_en: PASS - src='/splash-en.png', currentSrc ends with /splash-en.png, naturalWidth=848
test_results.splash_lang_de: PASS - src='/splash-de.png', currentSrc ends with /splash-de.png, naturalWidth=848
test_results.splash_lang_el: PASS - src='/splash-el.png', currentSrc ends with /splash-el.png, naturalWidth=848
test_results.splash_overlay_visible: PASS - [data-testid=splash-screen] is attached at DOM-ready and dismisses shortly after
test_results.service_worker_cleanup: PASS - 1 SW unregistered, 1 cache cleared before test to ensure no stale bundle

critical_code_review_comments: SplashScreen only uses lang at first mount; the show timer's useEffect has an empty dep array which is fine here, but note that switching language while the splash is showing would swap the image (motion.img key=src remounts) - acceptable behavior.
Splash assets are ~1.2-1.4MB each, which is heavy for a 2.5s splash. Consider serving compressed WebP/AVIF variants or preloading only the active language to save bandwidth on mobile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SplashScreen behavior fully verified. The service worker at public/service-worker.js required an explicit unregister + caches.delete before the first reload in this browser context to avoid a stale bundle. After that, plain page.reload() picks up the correct localStorage-driven splash for en/de/el. Splash element is [data-testid='splash-screen']; the inside carries the language-specific src. Auto-dismiss ~2.5s.
rca of the issue: No issue found. Prior agent's screenshot tool held a stale service-worker bundle; unregistering SW + clearing caches once at the start of the run resolved it and all three language variants matched perfectly.
